description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Batticaloa District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, including the postponement of local authority elections, notification of a new election date (25th April 2023), and listing of specific local government bodies where elections are affected. It directly relates to election scheduling and administration under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it clearly an Elections Gazette.
